titulo_youtube: chasqui: real-time simultaneous translation on your PC · from the Andes to Tokyo
descripcion_youtube:
500 years ago, the chasquis ran the Andes carrying messages. Today they cross languages.

chasqui is a small desktop window that translates speech as people talk: your calls in any app, both ways, or any video playing on your PC. Open source, with your own OpenAI API key: you pay by the minute, nothing else.

⬇️ Download (Windows 10/11, no Python): https://kvothesson.com/chasqui/?lang=en
💻 Code: https://github.com/kvothesson/chasqui
🐍 Or with pip: pip install chasqui-translate

🎧 HELP US TEST CALLS
Translating videos works. Two-way calls are the newest part, and they need a real call with a real person on the other side. If you have one coming up in Meet, Zoom, Teams or Discord, try chasqui in it and tell us how it went (even "it didn't work" helps):
https://github.com/kvothesson/chasqui/issues/new?template=used-it-for.yml

The voices and subtitles are chasqui's REAL output, uncorrected: an English sentence run through the app into Japanese, and the Japanese reply, back into English. The windows on screen are captures of the app.

The video is made 100% with code (Blender + Python), no AI image generation: https://github.com/kvothesson/procedural-anime
